stamps.stamp: window only: games_used_for_ratings 643, last_scored_week 8, season 2026, week 8

method: Each hub's own committed JSON is read; a value counts as published only when the file carries it under a recognised field name (r / pearson_r / coefficient / correlation) with a label. Values are shown exactly as stored, rounded to three decimals. A quantity is a conflict when two or more hubs publish different numbers for the same label - the board shows both and links both files. Nothing is averaged and nothing is re-derived here.
